findings.text: EPS $4.89 against $4.72 expected (+3.6%); revenue $92.28B against $90.62B expected (+1.8%). Results above estimates, reported 2026-10-28.
Q1 FY2027 (quarter ended 2026-09-30): Microsoft Cloud revenue was $63.9B, up 30%. Azure grew 48%, and commercial remaining performance obligation rose 73% to $677B.
Segment detail: Agents and Infra revenue was $76.8B, up 25%. Devices and Consumer revenue was $15.5B, down 3%, with Windows OEM and Devices down 22%.
GAAP diluted EPS was $4.92 and non-GAAP EPS was $4.89. The gap reflects a $0.03 net gain from OpenAI investments that non-GAAP excludes.
The company returned $10.2B to shareholders through dividends and buybacks in the quarter. A $0.98 quarterly dividend goes ex on 2026-11-19 and is payable 2026-12-10, up from $0.91 in prior quarters.

The release says forward guidance was given only on the earnings call and webcast, and the evidence does not quote a figure. The only forward view available is the current annual consensus: FY2027 EPS $20.09 and revenue $395.9B. No guidance change can be measured from the evidence.
Management commentary in the 2026-11-18 news: Nadella said AI tools are finding cybersecurity bugs at a fast pace, which makes more tech outages likely.
Over the past month to 2026-11-18, the technology sector fund XLK fell 11.7%, SPY fell 5.1% and MSFT fell 4.4%.
Over three months, XLK fell 10.5% and SPY fell 4.2%, while MSFT rose 5.6%. Over twelve months, MSFT rose 0.2%, XLK rose 15.5% and SPY rose 9.7%.
As of 2026-11-18, the VIX was 24.6, against a one-year median of 17.2 and a one-year range of 13.5 to 31.0. The near-term VIX is above the three-month level (inverted term structure).

Scheduled releases are Gross Domestic Product and Personal Income and Outlays on 2026-11-25, Employment Situation on 2026-12-04, and Consumer Price Index on 2026-12-10. The next FOMC decision is 2026-12-09.

definition.uncertainty: one standard error of the own base rate, counting independent windows only
